newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Ericsson started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ericsson started as a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has begun coverage of telecoms equipment firm Ericsson Telecomunicacoes S.A., the Brazilian unit of Swedish telecoms giant Ericsson AB, with a buy recommendation.
-- The brokerage said in a report that a surge in equipment orders and large investments planned in Brazil's telecommunications sector in the coming years offer bright prospects for the company.
-- "Ericsson had a backlog in September 1996 of $755.5 million, the same as its enrtire net sales for 1996," the brokerage said.
-- Fator said the Ericsson would likely end 1996 with orders totalling between $1.0 billion and $1.1 billion, compared with $530 million the prior year and $240 million in 1994.
-- Moreover, large planned investments in Brazil's telecoms sector "will result in demand from the market in which Ericsson operates," the brokerage said.

-- It also cited government plans to invest 62 billion reais in Brazil's telecoms sector between 1997 and 2003 and private investment expected to flow into the soon-to-be-privatized B Band cellular telephone sector.
-- "The only possible obstacle to this advancement is the kind of technology chosen for the digital cellular telephone," it added.

-- Fator said Ericsson's technological prowess will enable it to maintain its 36-percent share of the mobile cellular phone market, 41 percent of the public phone market and 11 percent of the transmission market.
-- Ericsson Telecomunicacoes' preferred share was up 0.20 reais at 21.20 reais while its voting common was down 0.50 reais at 20.50 reais at 1540 local/1240 est on the Sao Paulo bourse.
